name: Input Buffer
description: Snaps your slightly-early clicks to the exact frame of a bot replay, so clicking a few frames early still lands on the right frame.

replay-file.name: Replay file (.gdr2)
replay-file.description: The bot recording of the level that contains the correct click frames. Export it from Megahack's replay folder. Changes are picked up the next time the level restarts.

window.name: Correction window (frames)
window.description: A click up to this many frames BEFORE the replay's click is moved to the exact frame. Clicks earlier than this are left alone. 0 turns correction off.

frame-offset.name: Frame alignment (advanced)
frame-offset.description: Shifts which frame counts as the correct one. Leave at 0. If clicks consistently land 1 frame early or late compared to the replay, change this by 1.

debug.name: Show debug pop-ups
debug.description: Shows 'click snapped', 'click not corrected' and 'click sent' messages with frame numbers. Turn on to check the mod is working, then turn off.
